title: Ballad of the Slaying of U Thlen (Ka Rwai U Thlen ha Dainthlen)
khasi_title: Ka Rwai U Thlen ha Dainthlen
composer: Ancient Oral Bardic Tradition / U Soso Tham & U Rabon Singh
cultural_context: The seminal epic folk ballad of the Khasi highlands recount the collective uprising of courageous ancestors led by U Suidnoh against the man-eating serpent Thlen residing in the deep gorges of Dainthlen near Sohra. U Suidnoh befriended the monster with roasted goat meat before thrusting red-hot tongs of pig iron down its throat. The serpent was hauled upon the flat rocks at Dainthlen, cut into pieces, and consumed by all clans, establishing the eternal triumph of tip-briew tip-blei over greed and evil.
lyrics_khasi:
Ha krung ka krem ba-dum bajiw ha Dain-thlen,
U shong u Thlen u ksuid bamsap bamdoh;
U klun ia ki rangbah, ki kynthei, ki khunlung,
Ka ri ka iam, ka khuslai, ka byrngia.

Te mih U Suidnoh, u 'rang rangbah ka Ri,
Da ka buit, da ka jingshlur u leit rung ha krem;
Da u nar ba sait saw, u thang pynshit ding,
U thep ha u pdot ka sniang thlen ba bampoh!

Kynrup ki paidbah, ring pait u pyllon,
Ha kliar mawleiphu ha Dain-thlen ki dain;
Ot tukra-tukra, bam lut ki kur baroh,
Ban jah ka jingeh, ban khuid ka Ri-Khasi!

Wat sheptieng shuh ko khun ka Ri Lum,
Ba ka jingshai ka la jop ia ka dum;
To bat ia ka Hok, to bat ia ka Riti,
Khublei ko Blei Nongthaw ba pynim ia ngi!
lyrics_english:
In the deep, dark cavernous gorge of Dainthlen,
Dwelled U Thlen, the greedy devourer of human flesh;
Swallowing warriors, maidens, and tender babes,
The land wept in anguish, sorrow, and despair.

Then arose U Suidnoh, the fearless hero of the realm,
With sharp cunning and valor he stepped into the cave;
With iron rods forged glowing red in roaring flames,
He thrust down the throat of the beast the burning steel!

Then surged the united populace, dragging the serpent,
Upon the broad flat rock of Dainthlen they smote it down;
Cutting it into pieces, all clans consumed their share,
That the scourge be extinguished and Khasi land made pure!

Fear no more, O children of the Sacred Hills,
For the eternal Light hath conquered the darkness;
Hold fast unto Truth, hold fast unto Custom,
Praise be to God the Creator who hath delivered our people!

stanzas.title: Ka Krem U Thlen (The Cavern of the Serpent)
stanzas.khasi:
Ha krung ka krem ba-dum bajiw ha Dain-thlen,
U shong u Thlen u ksuid bamsap bamdoh;
U klun ia ki rangbah, ki kynthei, ki khunlung,
Ka ri ka iam, ka khuslai, ka byrngia.
stanzas.english: In the deep dark chasm of Dainthlen dwelled the serpent Thlen, swallowing travelers; the whole land wept in sorrow.

stanzas.title: Ka Buit U Suidnoh (The Valor and Cunning of Suidnoh)
stanzas.khasi:
Te mih U Suidnoh, u 'rang rangbah ka Ri,
Da ka buit, da ka jingshlur u leit rung ha krem;
Da u nar ba sait saw, u thang pynshit ding,
U thep ha u pdot ka sniang thlen ba bampoh!
stanzas.english: Then rose hero Suidnoh; with cunning and courage he fed the monster glowing red-hot iron, mortally burning its throat.

stanzas.title: Ka Jingpynduh ia U Thlen ha Dainthlen (The Slaying at Dainthlen Rocks)
stanzas.khasi:
Kynrup ki paidbah, ring pait u pyllon,
Ha kliar mawleiphu ha Dain-thlen ki dain;
Ot tukra-tukra, bam lut ki kur baroh,
Ban jah ka jingeh, ban khuid ka Ri-Khasi!
stanzas.english: The clans united, dragged out the monster, sliced it on the Dainthlen rocks and feasted, purifying the sacred hills.

stanzas.title: Ka Jingjop Jong Ka Jingshai (Triumph of the Light)
stanzas.khasi:
Wat sheptieng shuh ko khun ka Ri Lum,
Ba ka jingshai ka la jop ia ka dum;
To bat ia ka Hok, to bat ia ka Riti,
Khublei ko Blei Nongthaw ba pynim ia ngi!
stanzas.english: Fear not children of the Highlands; light has conquered darkness; hold to righteousness and honor God who delivered us.

vocabulary.dainthlen: The cutting or slicing of the serpent Thlen; also the name of the famous waterfall near Sohra
vocabulary.suidnoh: The legendary hero who outsmarted and slain U Thlen using heated red iron
vocabulary.krem: Cave, subterranean chasm, or limestone cavern
vocabulary.nar ba sait saw: Red-hot glowing iron forged in fire
